programmes.d: Paulie fights to prove that a homeless teenager isn't a murderer.
Tony is threatened with criminal negligence after the son of a prominent lawyer hangs himself in his cell.
In an attempt to take over Sonny Steelgrave's business, mob head Paul Patrice frames Sonny for several murder attempts he makes on the life of a special prosecutor.
A psychopathic murderer posing as Sonny's nephew double-crosses Sonny and holds Vinnie's girlfriend Gina hostage.
Hunter and McCall investigate the death of a multi-millionaire, whose four heirs become prime suspects.
The only clue in a series of murders is a trail of police-issued ammunition that leads Hunter and McCall to suspect a colleague as the killer.
A boy is the only witness to the shooting of his parents. As McCall attempts to unravel the circumstances surrounding the murders, Hunter must get the boy to talk about the shocking incident.
